title: Wolf Tooth Alt Performance Pedals
content:
The Wolf Tooth family of pedals continues to expand. The Minnesota-based manufacturer’s new Taiwan-made ALT Performance XC Pedals are at a lower price point than its ALT US-made pedals…

The ALT Performance pedals bring the same carefully designed shoe-to-pedal contact, low stack, and light weight to a lower price point for the first time. ALT is the brand’s first pedal model available in all three product tiers: the original Premium, US-made series ALT, the ultralight race-focused ALT MKØ, and now a Taiwan-made ALT Performance.

Alt Performance Quick Hits

  • $159.95 USD
  • Made in Taiwan
  • 326g / pair
  • 534 mm² contact area
  • 15mm pedal thickness
  • Fixed 55mm q-factor
  • Forged and post-machined pedal bodies
  • Satin chrome-plated chromoly steel axles and hardware
  • Available in five Color Shop finishes: Black, Raw Silver, Orange, Gold, and Red

Performance Series components were first rolled out in 2020, when we introduced Premium and Performance Series Headsets. These were followed up earlier this year with the launch of its CTRL Performance clipless and Waveform Performance flat pedals.

ALT Performance XC Pedals are designed for trail MTB riding, gravel, and ‘cross racing. These pedals are light and thin with a low stack height, and feature more platform area than the competition for better control and maximum power transfer. The open center between the cages gives these pedals increased mud-shedding capabilities when the weather isn’t on your side; they feature durable hard chrome-plated chromoly axles, fully SPD-compatible bindings, and a non-adjustable 55mm Q factor.

ALT Performance XC Pedals are designed in Minnesota, USA, made in Taiwan, and available in six Color Shop anodized finishes: Black, Red, Orange, Gold, and Raw Silver. Retail pricing is $159.95 USD / pair. Available now on wolftoothcomponents.com and via its network of dealers and distributors worldwide.
